title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Orsières 46.0833N 7.1667E, 27–29 August 2015–2025
claims: The archive query covers 2015-08-27 to 2025-08-29 and returns 3,656 daily records; filtered to 27–29 August it yields 33 days at the Orsières coordinates.
The API resolves the request to a model grid point at 46.1511N, 7.1656E with a grid elevation of 787 m.
Daily maximum temperature across those 33 days ranges from 13.4°C to 29.4°C, with a median of 26.2°C.
Daily minimum temperature across those 33 days ranges from 9.1°C to 19.7°C, with a median of 14.6°C.
14 of 33 days record at least 1 mm of precipitation and 9 of 33 record at least 5 mm.
The values are modelled historical data for a valley grid point, not measurements at Col de Balme or Tête de Balme, so they cannot be used as high-altitude race-day temperatures.
Open-Meteo data are published under CC BY 4.0 and require attribution.
